coverage.scope: Selected historical grants with independently verified named venues; not a nationwide or representative sample.

corpus_context.scope: Available desktop GrantConnect corpus. These counts do not claim verified project locations, payments or complete nationwide coverage.

methodology.timeline: Awards enter the view on their GrantConnect publication date. Values reflect the current retrieved notice and may include later amendments. This is not a reconstruction of payments or knowledge at the selected date.
methodology.geography: Points locate named project venues using primary venue/council sources and separately documented facility geometries. They are not recipient headquarters, postcode centroids or surveyed works footprints.
methodology.money: Each grant is counted once. No per-site allocation, payment date or completed-work claim is inferred.
methodology.electorates: 2025 AEC boundaries locate the current venue; historical boundaries may differ.
methodology.selection: A small deliberately checked selection across years and programs. Do not rank electorates or infer wider grant distribution from this sample.
methodology.attribution: Some venue geometry © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
